title: Best Epilators UK
short: Four epilators compared for comfort, versatility and results, from a full-body 5-in-1 tool to a dedicated facial model.
intro: An epilator plucks hair from the root using rotating tweezers, so hair grows back finer and sparser over time, and you don't need to wait between sessions the way you do with waxing. This guide is based on Expert Reviews' tested roundup, comparing tweezer count, attachments, comfort features and versatility across full-body and facial epilators. Prices are as reviewed.

products.name: Silk-épil 9 Beauty Set 5-in-1
products.best_for: Anyone who wants one tool covering epilating, shaving, exfoliating and more
products.key_spec: 40 tweezers, cordless, wet and dry, 2 speeds, pivoting head, Smartlight, shaver head attachment included
products.summary: Expert Reviews' top pick and the priciest on the list: a five-in-one tool that exfoliates and massages as well as epilating, with a shaver head attachment so it also works as a full electric shaver. The pivoting head is especially effective at catching hairs on difficult areas like knees, and the Smartlight helps you see what you're doing in poorly lit rooms. The 12 included attachments verge on overkill.
pros: Five-in-one: epilates, shaves, exfoliates and more
Pivoting head catches hairs in difficult areas
Smartlight helps in badly lit rooms
cons: The 12 attachments can feel like overkill

products.name: Series 8000 Wet and Dry BRE740/11
products.best_for: Curved areas and reducing discomfort with a trim-first approach
products.key_spec: 32 tweezers, cordless, wet and dry, 48,200-bristle exfoliation head, rotating foot file, 9 accessories
products.summary: Expert Reviews found a long handle and wide, curved head with a built-in light that's easy to steer and removes many hairs at once on curved areas. A body exfoliation head buffs dead skin and helps prevent ingrown hairs, a comb trims longer hair first to reduce pain, and a contact cap gently stretches skin so you don't need a second hand. It's noisier than some rivals, but nine easily swapped attachments make it quick to use.
pros: Wide, curved head with built-in light
Exfoliation head and foot file included
Trimming comb and contact cap reduce discomfort
products.search: Philips Series 8000 Wet and Dry Epilator BRE740

products.name: FaceSpa Pro 911
products.best_for: Delicate facial areas like the upper lip and chin
products.key_spec: 10 tweezers, cordless, dry only, 4 speed/intensity settings, 20-second treatment timer, 100-day money-back guarantee
products.summary: Expert Reviews notes it's wise to use a tool designed specifically for facial fuzz, and this Braun is much smaller than a regular epilator with a slim head for delicate areas. Four speed and intensity settings personalise the treatment, and a 20-second timer stops you overdoing it. It comes with a cleansing brush and toning attachment (though the toning benefit beyond a gentle vibration is unclear), plus a stand, travel pouch and 100-day guarantee.
pros: Slim head designed specifically for facial hair
cons: Toning attachment's benefit beyond vibration is unclear

products.name: Silk-épil 5 Power 5825
products.best_for: A less painful dry epilation experience at a lower price
products.key_spec: 40 tweezers, corded, wet and dry, high-frequency massage system, pivoting head, smart light
products.summary: Expert Reviews found proof that dry epilation doesn't have to be painful: a built-in high-frequency massage system stimulates the skin to minimise discomfort, making it much less painful than many wet and dry models. A pivoting head catches hairs in difficult places without going over the same area repeatedly, and a smart light helps in nooks and crannies. It comes with a shaver and trimmer attachment and doesn't cost a fortune.
cons: Corded, so less portable than cordless rivals

guide.a: Because it plucks hair from the follicle, some discomfort is normal, but this varies by person and by epilator. Features that reduce pain include a trimming comb to shorten hair first (Philips Series 8000), a high-frequency massage system (Braun Silk-épil 5), and a contact cap that stretches skin for you (Philips Series 8000).

Cordless epilators, like the Braun Silk-épil 9 and Philips Series 8000, are more portable and can be used almost anywhere, though battery-powered models tend to be less powerful. A corded model like the Braun Silk-épil 5 gives consistent power at a lower price, and a charged cordless model is also fairly portable.

guide.q: Do I need a wet and dry epilator?
guide.a: Wet and dry models can be used in the bath or shower, where heat opens pores and can reduce pain, but epilating in water is slower and less effective. Unless you have a low pain threshold, a dry-only epilator like the Braun FaceSpa Pro is fine for facial hair.

guide.q: Should I buy a dedicated facial epilator?
guide.a: Expert Reviews recommends a tool designed specifically for facial hair, like the Braun FaceSpa Pro, which has a smaller, slimmer head suited to the upper lip and chin, rather than using a full-size body epilator on delicate facial skin.
